```{r setup}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What to set for a report
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The path to the config file, whose financialreport section names the
# combined Silver layer:
#
#   FINCOMMONS_CONFIG=/path/to/paths.yaml quarto render financialreport-coverage-report.qmd
#
# Everything else follows from the lake: which regimes it holds, for which
# years, and what their filings state.
config_path <- Sys.getenv("FINCOMMONS_CONFIG", "paths.yaml")

# How many financial years the charts go back from the latest one any regime
# holds annual reports for. The Commission's company files reach back to
# 2009, and a chart over all of it would make the two younger regimes a
# sliver at its right edge.
n_years <- 10

# The point size of the text in a chart.
chart_base_size <- 9

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# What the report counts as what
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# The regimes, in the order every table and chart takes them, and what they
# are called on the page.
regimes <- c(esef = "ESEF", sec = "SEC", edinet = "EDINET")
regime_long <- c(esef = "ESEF, the European Union",
                 sec = "SEC, the United States",
                 edinet = "EDINET, Japan")
frameworks <- c("IFRS", "US-GAAP", "JP-GAAP")

# The forms of an annual report. An ESEF filing is annual by construction --
# the regime covers the annual financial report alone -- and names no form.
# A filing with the Commission may be quarterly, and one with the Financial
# Services Agency may be any of some thirty documents, most of which are not
# accounts at all. The sector factsheet of the esef module uses the same
# list, and so does the comparison report beside this one.
annual_forms <- c("10-K", "10-K/A", "20-F", "20-F/A", "40-F", "40-F/A",
                  "120", "130")

# The EDINET document types this report names. The agency numbers every
# document it receives, and the code alone says nothing to a reader; the
# ones a lake is likely to hold are named, the rest are shown as their code.
edinet_forms <- c(
  "030" = "Securities registration statement",
  "040" = "Amended securities registration statement",
  "120" = "Annual securities report",
  "130" = "Amended annual securities report",
  "140" = "Quarterly report",
  "150" = "Amended quarterly report",
  "160" = "Semi-annual report",
  "170" = "Amended semi-annual report",
  "180" = "Extraordinary report",
  "190" = "Amended extraordinary report",
  "220" = "Share buyback status report",
  "230" = "Amended share buyback status report",
  "235" = "Internal control report",
  "236" = "Amended internal control report",
  "350" = "Large shareholding report",
  "360" = "Amended large shareholding report")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The design and the libraries
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# One design script for the whole package, in the templates directory at
# its root; a copy beside this template wins over it.
library(ggplot2)
design_file <- "r-corporate-design-functions-ggplot2.R"
design_path <- c(design_file, file.path("..", "..", "..", "templates", design_file))
design_path <- design_path[file.exists(design_path)]
if (length(design_path) == 0) {
  stop("The corporate design script ", design_file, " is neither beside this ",
       "template nor in the templates directory of the package.")
}
source(design_path[1])

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(yaml)
library(arrow)

if (!grepl("UTF-8", Sys.getlocale("LC_CTYPE"), ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  stop("The session does not run in a UTF-8 locale, so the names of issuers ",
       "and the typographic characters of this report would print as ",
       "<U+00B7> escapes. Render with LANG=en_US.UTF-8.")
}

# A financial year is named by the calendar year it mostly falls in: a year
# ending on or before 30 June counts as the year before, so a Japanese year
# to 31 March 2026 is 2025, as it is in every report of the package.
period_year <- function(date) {
  y <- as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))
  ifelse(as.integer(format(date, "%m")) <= 6L, y - 1L, y)
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The catalogue of measures
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

catalogue_file <- "financialreport_measures.csv"
catalogue_path <- c(catalogue_file,
                    file.path("..", "..", "..", "data", catalogue_file))
catalogue_path <- catalogue_path[file.exists(catalogue_path)]
if (length(catalogue_path) == 0) {
  stop("The catalogue of measures ", catalogue_file, " is neither beside ",
       "this template nor in the data directory of the package.")
}
catalogue <- read.csv(catalogue_path[1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                      encoding = "UTF-8") %>%
  as_tibble()
measures <- c("revenue", "profit_loss", "profit_loss_attributable_to_parent",
              "assets", "liabilities", "equity",
              "equity_attributable_to_parent", "cash_and_equivalents")
unknown <- setdiff(unique(catalogue$measure), measures)
if (length(unknown) > 0) {
  stop("The catalogue of measures defines ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "),
       ", which this report does not know how to show. Add it to `measures`.")
}
measure_names <- c(
  revenue = "Revenue",
  profit_loss = "Result for the year",
  profit_loss_attributable_to_parent = "Result, owners of the parent",
  assets = "Total assets",
  liabilities = "Total liabilities",
  equity = "Equity",
  equity_attributable_to_parent = "Equity, owners of the parent",
  cash_and_equivalents = "Cash and cash equivalents")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The Silver layer
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

yaml_paths <- read_yaml(config_path)
path_silver <- yaml_paths[["financialreport"]][["silver"]]
if (is.list(path_silver)) path_silver <- path_silver[["path"]]
if (is.null(path_silver)) {
  stop("The config file ", config_path, " names no Silver layer for ",
       "financialreport.")
}

# arrow reads every parquet file under a directory, and a Delta table keeps
# the files it has replaced until it is vacuumed, so a Delta table read this
# way would count a filing once for every time it was written.
for (table in c("fact", "filing")) {
  if (!dir.exists(file.path(path_silver, table))) {
    stop("The combined Silver layer in ", path_silver, " has no ", table,
         " table. Build it with fincommons.financialreport.combined.",
         "update_silver_financialreport.")
  }
  if (dir.exists(file.path(path_silver, table, "_delta_log"))) {
    stop("The ", table, " table of the combined module is a Delta table, ",
         "which this template does not read. Write the Silver layer as ",
         "parquet, or read the table through Spark.")
  }
}

filings_all <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "filing")) %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(source = as.character(source),
         read = !is.na(facts) & facts > 0,
         annual = source == "esef" | form %in% annual_forms,
         fy = period_year(period_end),
         issuer = paste0(coalesce(lei, ""), "|", coalesce(cik, ""), "|",
                         coalesce(edinet_code, "")))

held <- intersect(names(regimes), unique(filings_all$source))
if (length(held) == 0) {
  stop("The table of filings of ", path_silver, " is empty.")
}
regimes_held <- regimes[held]

read <- filings_all %>% filter(read)

# An investment fund files its annual report with the agency under the same
# document type as a company, 120, and in a lake that collected the agency's
# indexes for a few weeks most of the annual reports are funds': 456 of 605
# in the one this report was written against. A fund is not a company -- its
# revenue is the income of a portfolio and its equity ratio close to one --
# and pooled with companies it would move every median of the Japanese
# column. A fund's report is told by its concepts: it tags the fund
# taxonomies `jpsps*` or the fund elements of the financial statements
# taxonomy, whose names end in `FND`. Its reports are counted as what they
# are and left out of every statistic of the measures.
edinet_annual_ids <- read$filing[read$source == "edinet" & read$annual]
fund_ids <- if (length(edinet_annual_ids) == 0) character(0) else
  open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "fact")) %>%
    filter(source == "edinet", filing %in% edinet_annual_ids,
           grepl("^jpsps", concept) | grepl("FND$", concept)) %>%
    distinct(filing) %>%
    collect() %>%
    pull(filing)
read <- read %>%
  mutate(fund = source == "edinet" & filing %in% fund_ids)

annual_all <- read %>% filter(annual, !is.na(fy))
annual <- annual_all %>% filter(!fund)
latest_year <- max(annual$fy)
years_charted <- seq(latest_year - n_years + 1, latest_year)

# The measures each annual report states: the materialised `measure` column
# of the fact table, for the entity as a whole and for the period the filing
# reports on. A measure is named only on the concept the catalogue ranks
# first for its framework, so a report stating revenue only as IFRS 15
# revenue does not count as stating revenue here; that is the population
# every benchmark built on this column is taken over.
#
# A figure under a dimension is a part of the entity and is left out, with
# the one exception `measure_values` of the combined module makes: a
# Japanese report states its group's figures with no dimension and its
# parent company's own under `NonConsolidatedMember`, and a filer that
# prepares no consolidated statements states only the second. That member
# names which accounts a figure belongs to, not a part of them, and leaving
# it out would leave out most Japanese filers. Where a report states both,
# the group's figure is the one taken, as there.
basis_members <- c("NonConsolidatedMember")
stated <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "fact")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(measure), !is.na(value), prd_end == period_end,
         is.na(dimensions) | dimensions %in% basis_members) %>%
  select(source, filing, framework, measure, dimensions) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(source = as.character(source)) %>%
  # A measure counts under the framework of the filing. A Japanese group
  # reporting under IFRS states its parent company's own accounts under
  # Japan GAAP in the same report, and those are not the report's figures.
  semi_join(annual, by = c("source", "filing", "framework")) %>%
  group_by(source, filing, framework, measure) %>%
  summarise(group = any(is.na(dimensions)), .groups = "drop")

# The Japanese reports whose measures are the parent company's alone: a
# filer without subsidiaries, or one whose group figures the report does not
# tag. Their figures are accounts of one company rather than of a group, as
# any other filer without subsidiaries states, and are counted beside them.
parent_only <- stated %>%
  group_by(source, filing) %>%
  summarise(group = any(group), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!group)

fact_count <- sum(read$facts)
```

```{r title, results='asis'}
# The title of the document, which a screen reader announces and without
# which typst refuses to write a PDF/UA document.
typst_document_title(paste0("Financial reports across regimes: coverage of ",
                            paste(regimes_held, collapse = ", "),
                            ", financial years ", min(annual$fy), "–",
                            latest_year))
```

```{r formats}
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & abs(x) < 0.5 / 10^digits, 0, x)
  ifelse(is.na(x), "–",
         formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",",
                 decimal.mark = "."))
}
big <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x >= 1e6, paste0(formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1), " m"),
         fmt(x))
}
wrap_caption <- function(text, width = 125) {
  paste(strwrap(text, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}
source_caption <- caption_corporate_design(
  source = paste("filings.xbrl.org, SEC EDGAR, EDINET;",
                 "the combined tables of fincommons.financialreport."),
  lang = "en")
# It is named apart from typst_string of the design script, which also puts
# the quotes around the text and which the title of the document and its
# coloured tables call: a function of the same name here would replace it.
typst_escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x)
  gsub("\"", "\\\\\"", x)
}
ts <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "–", as.character(x))
  paste0("\"", typst_escape(x), "\"")
}

# A table written as Typst rather than as a Markdown table, which gives the
# columns the widths they need instead of the ones Pandoc guesses from the
# length of their header.
typst_table <- function(df, widths, align, size = 7.5) {
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    paste(ts(unlist(df[i, ], use.names = FALSE)), collapse = ", ")
  }, character(1))
  paste0(
    "\n```{=typst}\n#block(width: 100%, text(size: ", size, "pt, {\n",
    "set par(justify: false)\ntable(\n",
    "  columns: (", paste(widths, collapse = ", "), "),\n",
    "  align: (", paste(align, collapse = ", "), "),\n",
    "  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 2.8pt),\n",
    "  stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { (top: 0.7pt + rgb(\"#22282E\"), ",
    "bottom: 0.4pt + rgb(\"#22282E\")) } else { none },\n",
    "  table.header(", paste0("text(weight: \"bold\", ", ts(names(df)), ")",
                             collapse = ", "), "),\n  ",
    paste(cells, collapse = ",\n  "),
    ",\n  table.hline(stroke: 0.7pt + rgb(\"#22282E\"))\n)}))\n```\n\n")
}

cols <- design_colours()
# The colours of the regimes are the first three of the accessible palette of
# the design, which stay apart for a reader who does not see red or green;
# the comparison report beside this one uses the same three. No chart tells
# the regimes apart by colour alone: each regime has a panel of its own.
regime_colours <- setNames(palette_accessible[1:3], c("ESEF", "SEC", "EDINET"))
```

```{r cover, results='asis'}
title <- "Financial reports across regimes"
subtitle <- paste0("What the combined tables hold: ",
                   paste(regimes_held, collapse = ", "), ", financial years ",
                   min(annual$fy), "–", latest_year)

tile <- function(value, label, colour) {
  paste0("box(width: 100%, inset: (x: 8pt, y: 7pt), stroke: (left: 2pt + rgb(\"",
         colour, "\")), [#text(size: 17pt, weight: \"bold\", ", ts(value),
         ")\\ #text(size: 7.5pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"), ", ts(label), ")])")
}

per_regime <- read %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(filings = n(), issuers = n_distinct(issuer), facts = sum(facts),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(annual %>% count(source, name = "annual"), by = "source") %>%
  left_join(annual_all %>% filter(fund) %>% count(source, name = "funds"),
            by = "source")

lines <- vapply(held, function(s) {
  r <- per_regime %>% filter(source == s)
  paste0("**", regime_long[[s]], "**: ", fmt(r$filings), " filings read of ",
         fmt(sum(filings_all$source == s)), " listed, from ", fmt(r$issuers),
         " issuers, ", fmt(coalesce(r$annual, 0L)), " of them annual reports",
         ifelse(coalesce(r$funds, 0L) > 0,
                paste0(" of companies and ", fmt(r$funds), " of investment funds"),
                ""), ".")
}, character(1))

cat("```{=typst}\n")
cat("#set page(header: [#set text(size: 7pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"))\n",
    "  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), [#text(weight: \"bold\", ",
    ts("Financial reports across regimes"), ") #h(6pt) #text(",
    ts("Coverage of the combined tables"), ")], [#text(",
    ts(paste("Rendered on", format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y"))), ")])\n",
    "  #v(-4pt) #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb(\"#DCE1E5\"))],\n",
    "  footer: [#set text(size: 7pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"))\n",
    "  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb(\"#DCE1E5\")) #v(-2pt)\n",
    "  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), [#text(",
    ts("Source: filings.xbrl.org, SEC EDGAR, EDINET; fincommons.financialreport."),
    ")], [#context counter(page).display()])],\n  numbering: \"1\")\n", sep = "")
cat("#text(size: 8pt, tracking: 1.6pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"), ",
    ts("COVERAGE REPORT · ESEF · SEC · EDINET"), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("#v(2pt)\n#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + rgb(\"#C10016\"))\n#v(8pt)\n")
cat("#text(size: 21pt, weight: \"bold\", ", ts(title), ")\n#v(1pt)\n", sep = "")
cat("#text(size: 10pt, fill: rgb(\"#5C666F\"), ", ts(subtitle), ")\n#v(10pt)\n", sep = "")
cat("#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 8pt,\n  ",
    tile(fmt(nrow(read)), "filings read", cols[["ink"]]), ",\n  ",
    tile(fmt(n_distinct(read$issuer)), "issuers", cols[["ink"]]), ",\n  ",
    tile(fmt(nrow(annual)), "annual reports of companies", cols[["blue"]]), ",\n  ",
    tile(big(fact_count), "facts", cols[["blue"]]),
    "\n)\n#v(8pt)\n", sep = "")
cat("```\n\n")
cat("The combined tables put the filings of the tagging regimes side by side ",
    "in one set of columns, and resolve eight measures -- revenue, the ",
    "result, total assets, liabilities, equity and cash, and the parent's ",
    "share of the result and of equity -- to the concept each framework ",
    "states them under. This report says what they hold and how much of it ",
    "a comparison across regimes can use.\n\n", sep = "")
cat(paste0("- ", lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
```

## What each regime holds

```{r regime-table, results='asis'}
framework_mix <- read %>%
  mutate(framework = coalesce(framework, "none")) %>%
  count(source, framework) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(mix = paste0(framework, " ", fmt(n), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop")
temp <- per_regime %>%
  left_join(filings_all %>% count(source, name = "listed"), by = "source") %>%
  left_join(annual %>% group_by(source) %>%
              summarise(from = min(fy), to = max(fy), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "source") %>%
  left_join(framework_mix, by = "source") %>%
  mutate(order = match(source, names(regimes))) %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  transmute(Regime = unname(regimes[source]),
            Listed = fmt(listed), Read = fmt(filings),
            `Annual reports` = fmt(coalesce(annual, 0L)),
            Funds = ifelse(coalesce(funds, 0L) > 0, fmt(funds), ""),
            Issuers = fmt(issuers), Facts = big(facts),
            Years = ifelse(is.na(from), "–", paste0(from, "–", to)),
            `Filings read by framework` = mix)
cat(typst_table(temp, widths = c("auto", rep("auto", 7), "1fr"),
                align = c("left", rep("right", 6), "left", "left")))
cat("*Listed* is every filing the source index names, *read* the ones whose ",
    "facts the lake holds. An ESEF filing is listed for the whole repository ",
    "and read only for the countries collected; an EDINET filing is listed ",
    "for every day of the indexes collected, whatever the document. The ",
    "framework is the one a filing's concepts belong to, which for a foreign ",
    "issuer filing with the Commission under IFRS is IFRS and not US-GAAP. ",
    "*none* is a filing no accounting framework applies to, such as a large ",
    "shareholding report. *Annual reports* are those of companies; *funds* ",
    "the annual reports of investment funds, which the agency receives under ",
    "the same document type and which this report leaves out of every ",
    "statistic below.\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r years-data}
temp <- annual %>%
  filter(fy %in% years_charted) %>%
  count(source, fy) %>%
  mutate(regime = factor(unname(regimes[source]), levels = unname(regimes)))

# What the chart shows, as text for its alt text: each regime's count year by
# year, and the year it holds most reports for.
alt_years <- if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
  paste0("Bar chart of the annual reports of companies read by financial year, ",
         "which is empty: the lake holds no annual report of a company in the ",
         "years ", min(years_charted), " to ", max(years_charted), ".")
} else {
  per_regime_years <- temp %>%
    arrange(regime, fy) %>%
    group_by(regime) %>%
    summarise(text = paste0(regime[1], ", ", fmt(sum(n)), " in all, most in ",
                            fy[which.max(n)], ": ",
                            paste0(fy, " ", fmt(n), collapse = ", ")),
              .groups = "drop")
  paste0("Bar chart in one panel per regime of the annual reports of companies ",
         "read, by financial year from ", min(years_charted), " to ",
         max(years_charted), ", on one scale. ",
         paste(per_regime_years$text, collapse = ". "), ".")
}
```

```{r years-chart}
#| fig-height: 2.6
#| fig-alt: !expr alt_years
# One panel per regime, named above it, rather than the bars of the regimes
# side by side and told apart by their colour; the panels share one scale.
ggplot(temp, aes(x = factor(fy, levels = years_charted), y = n, fill = regime)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_zeroline() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = regime_colours, drop = TRUE, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE,
                   labels = function(y) ifelse(as.integer(y) %% 2 == latest_year %% 2, y, "")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .06)), labels = function(x) fmt(x)) +
  facet_wrap(~regime, nrow = 1) +
  labs(subtitle = "Annual reports of companies read, by financial year",
       caption = wrap_caption(source_caption)) +
  theme_corporate_design(base_size = chart_base_size, grid = "y",
                         axis.title = element_blank())
```

```{r forms, results='asis'}
temp <- read %>%
  filter(source != "esef") %>%
  mutate(form = coalesce(form, "none")) %>%
  count(source, form, annual) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(order = match(source, names(regimes)),
         What = case_when(
           source == "edinet" & form %in% names(edinet_forms) ~ unname(edinet_forms[form]),
           source == "edinet" ~ "Other document type",
           form %in% c("10-K", "20-F", "40-F") ~ "Annual report",
           form %in% c("10-K/A", "20-F/A", "40-F/A") ~ "Amended annual report",
           form == "10-Q" ~ "Quarterly report",
           TRUE ~ "Other form")) %>%
  arrange(order, desc(n)) %>%
  transmute(Regime = unname(regimes[source]), Form = form, What,
            `Annual?` = ifelse(annual, "yes", ""), Filings = fmt(n))
if (nrow(temp) > 0) {
  cat("### The forms filed with the Commission and the agency\n\n")
  cat(typst_table(temp, widths = c("auto", "auto", "1fr", "auto", "auto"),
                  align = c("left", "left", "left", "left", "right")))
  cat("The eight forms most often read from each regime. Only annual ",
      "reports enter the comparisons of the measures below and of the report ",
      "beside this one: a quarter's result over a year's equity is not a ",
      "return, and most of what the agency publishes is not accounts at ",
      "all.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Which measures the annual reports state

```{r measure-heatmap, results='asis'}
columns <- annual %>%
  filter(!is.na(framework)) %>%
  count(source, framework, name = "reports")
temp <- stated %>%
  count(source, framework, measure, name = "stating") %>%
  right_join(columns %>% tidyr::crossing(measure = measures),
             by = c("source", "framework", "measure")) %>%
  mutate(stating = coalesce(stating, 0L),
         share = stating / reports * 100,
         defined = paste(measure, framework) %in%
           paste(catalogue$measure, catalogue$framework),
         label = ifelse(defined, paste0(fmt(share), "%"), "n/a"),
         column = factor(paste0(regimes[source], "\n", framework, "\n(",
                                fmt(reports), ")"),
                         levels = unique(paste0(regimes[source], "\n", framework,
                                                "\n(", fmt(reports), ")")[
                           order(match(source, names(regimes)),
                                 match(framework, frameworks))])),
         measure = factor(unname(measure_names[measure]),
                          levels = rev(unname(measure_names))))

# A table rather than a picture of one: the shares are text a screen reader
# reads, the header names the regime, the framework and the number of
# reports of each column, and the blue that deepens with the share only
# repeats the number in its cell. A measure the catalogue defines no concept
# for is n/a in its cell and grey.
row_order <- unname(measure_names)
column_order <- levels(droplevels(temp$column))
cell_of <- function(field) {
  m <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(row_order), ncol = length(column_order))
  m[cbind(match(as.character(temp$measure), row_order),
          match(as.character(temp$column), column_order))] <- field
  m
}
shade <- scales::seq_gradient_pal(cols[["seq_low"]], cols[["blue"]])
typst_colour_table(
  row_order,
  cell_of(temp$label),
  cell_of(ifelse(temp$defined, shade(pmin(pmax(temp$share, 0), 100) / 100),
                 cols[["grid"]])),
  sub("\n", " ", sub("\n", " ", column_order, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE),
  paste0("Share of the annual reports of companies that state each measure, by ",
         "regime and framework; the number of reports in brackets. The blue ",
         "deepens with the share; n/a and grey mark a measure the catalogue ",
         "defines no concept for under that framework. ", source_caption),
  row_header_title = "Measure")
```

```{r measure-notes, results='asis'}
low <- temp %>% filter(defined, share < 50) %>%
  arrange(share)
cat("A report states a measure where it tags, for the entity as a whole and ",
    "for its own period, the concept the catalogue of measures ranks first ",
    "for its framework. ",
    if (nrow(parent_only) > 0) paste0(
      fmt(nrow(parent_only)), " of the ",
      fmt(sum(annual$source == "edinet")), " Japanese annual reports of ",
      "companies state ",
      "their measures only for the parent company, under ",
      "`NonConsolidatedMember`: they prepare no consolidated statements, and ",
      "their figures are counted as the accounts of the entity, as those of ",
      "any filer without subsidiaries are. ") else "",
    "*n/a* is a measure the catalogue defines no concept ",
    "for under that framework: Japan GAAP has no line for the equity ",
    "attributable to the parent, which is a sum of two lines of a Japanese ",
    "balance sheet rather than one, and the catalogue leaves it out rather ",
    "than take a part for the whole. A company without subsidiaries has no ",
    "non-controlling interests and states no parent's share of its result ",
    "or equity, which is why those rows are low wherever such companies ",
    "are many. ", sep = "")
if (nrow(low) > 0) {
  cat("Where a share is low the measure is usually there under another ",
      "concept rather than missing: a report stating revenue only as IFRS 15 ",
      "revenue, or an American registrant stating its result only as the ",
      "parent's share, counts as not stating the first concept. ",
      "The lowest shares are ",
      paste0(as.character(low$measure), " under ", sub("\n.*", "", low$column),
             " ", low$framework, " (", fmt(low$share), " %)")[seq_len(min(3, nrow(low)))] %>%
        paste(collapse = ", "),
      ".\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

### The result: the total or the parent's share

```{r profit-basis, results='asis'}
basis <- annual %>%
  filter(!is.na(framework)) %>%
  select(source, filing, framework) %>%
  left_join(stated %>%
              filter(measure %in% c("profit_loss",
                                    "profit_loss_attributable_to_parent")) %>%
              mutate(flag = TRUE) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = flag),
            by = c("source", "filing", "framework"))
for (key in c("profit_loss", "profit_loss_attributable_to_parent")) {
  if (!key %in% names(basis)) basis[[key]] <- NA
}
temp <- basis %>%
  mutate(total = coalesce(profit_loss, FALSE),
         parent = coalesce(profit_loss_attributable_to_parent, FALSE),
         what = case_when(total & parent ~ "both",
                          total ~ "total only",
                          parent ~ "parent's share only",
                          TRUE ~ "neither")) %>%
  count(source, framework, what) %>%
  group_by(source, framework) %>%
  mutate(share = n / sum(n) * 100, reports = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = what, values_from = share, values_fill = 0)
for (key in c("both", "total only", "parent's share only", "neither")) {
  if (!key %in% names(temp)) temp[[key]] <- 0
}
temp <- temp %>%
  arrange(match(source, names(regimes)), match(framework, frameworks)) %>%
  transmute(Regime = unname(regimes[source]), Framework = framework,
            Reports = fmt(reports), `Both, %` = fmt(both),
            `Total only, %` = fmt(`total only`),
            `Parent's share only, %` = fmt(`parent's share only`),
            `Neither, %` = fmt(neither))
cat(typst_table(temp, widths = c("auto", "auto", "1fr", rep("auto", 4)),
                align = c("left", "left", rep("right", 5))))
cat("The two regimes lean opposite ways, and no catalogue of concepts can ",
    "make them meet. Most European reports state the result for the year ",
    "including the non-controlling interests and many state the parent's ",
    "share beside it; most American registrants state only the parent's ",
    "share, under `us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss`, and the total only where there are ",
    "minorities to attribute it to. A comparison of results across regimes ",
    "therefore takes the total where it is stated and the parent's share ",
    "where it is not, and has to say which it took -- as the comparison ",
    "report beside this one does.\n\n", sep = "")
```

## The catalogue of measures

```{r catalogue, results='asis'}
first <- catalogue %>%
  arrange(measure, framework, priority) %>%
  group_by(measure, framework) %>%
  summarise(concept = paste0(element[1],
                             ifelse(n() > 1, paste0(" (+", n() - 1, ")"), "")),
            caveats = sum(nzchar(caveat)),
            .groups = "drop")
temp <- tidyr::crossing(measure = measures, framework = frameworks) %>%
  left_join(first, by = c("measure", "framework")) %>%
  mutate(cell = ifelse(is.na(concept), "–",
                       paste0(concept, ifelse(caveats > 0, " *", "")))) %>%
  select(measure, framework, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = framework, values_from = cell) %>%
  mutate(order = match(measure, measures)) %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  transmute(Measure = unname(measure_names[measure]),
            IFRS = .data[["IFRS"]], `US-GAAP` = .data[["US-GAAP"]],
            `JP-GAAP` = .data[["JP-GAAP"]])
breakable <- function(x) gsub("([a-z])([A-Z])", "\\1\u200b\\2", x, perl = TRUE)
temp <- temp %>% mutate(across(c(IFRS, `US-GAAP`, `JP-GAAP`), breakable))
cat(typst_table(temp, widths = c("auto", "1fr", "1fr", "1fr"),
                align = rep("left", 4), size = 7))
cat("The element each framework's first concept names, with the number of ",
    "further concepts the catalogue accepts after it in brackets; IFRS ",
    "covers both `ifrs-full` and Japan's own IFRS taxonomy `jpigp_cor`, of ",
    "which the European one is shown. * marks a row that carries a caveat: ",
    fmt(sum(nzchar(catalogue$caveat))), " of the catalogue's ",
    fmt(nrow(catalogue)), " rows do. Nothing in the catalogue is an official ",
    "correspondence -- there is none between IFRS and US GAAP -- and the ",
    "README of `fincommons.financialreport.combined` gives the basis and the ",
    "caveat of every row; `caveats()` prints them.\n\n", sep = "")
```

## How to read this report

```{r notes, results='asis'}
semi_annual <- read %>% filter(source == "edinet", form == "160")
semi_annual_late <- semi_annual %>%
  filter(!is.na(period_end), period_end > Sys.Date())
undated <- read %>% filter(is.na(period_end))
notes <- c(
  paste0("**What it reads.** The two tables of `fincommons.financialreport.",
         "combined`, *filing* and *fact*, which the module builds from the ",
         "Silver tables of the esef, sec and edinet modules. It reads them as ",
         "they are and changes nothing; the README of the module describes ",
         "every column."),
  paste0("**Which filings count.** A filing counts as read where the lake ",
         "holds facts for it, and as an annual report where its regime says ",
         "so: every ESEF filing, the forms 10-K, 20-F and 40-F and their ",
         "amendments with the Commission, and the document types 120 and 130 ",
         "with the agency. A report filed twice for one year -- an amendment, ",
         "a second language -- counts twice here, since this report counts ",
         "what the lake holds; the comparison report keeps one per issuer and ",
         "year."),
  paste0("**Which year.** A financial year is the calendar year it mostly ",
         "falls in: a year ending on or before 30 June counts as the year ",
         "before, so a Japanese year to 31 March 2026 is 2025."),
  if (nrow(undated) > 0) paste0(
    "**Filings without a period.** ", fmt(nrow(undated)), " filings read ",
    "state no period end", if (any(undated$source == "edinet")) paste0(
      ", ", fmt(sum(undated$source == "edinet")), " of them EDINET documents ",
      "that report no accounts -- large shareholding, extraordinary and ",
      "buyback reports and the like") else "",
    ". They are counted as read but have no financial year, and no measure ",
    "of theirs enters a comparison."),
  if (nrow(semi_annual_late) > 0) paste0(
    "**A semi-annual report dated at its year end.** ",
    fmt(nrow(semi_annual_late)), " of the ", fmt(nrow(semi_annual)),
    " EDINET semi-annual reports read carry a period end after today: ",
    "the table records the end of the financial year the half-year belongs ",
    "to, not the end of the half-year itself. They are not annual reports ",
    "and are in no comparison, but a question about them should read the ",
    "periods of their facts rather than the period of the filing."),
  paste0("This report is produced by a template of the open-source project ",
         "fincommons. It reads public records, is given without warranty as ",
         "to correctness or completeness, and carries no association with ",
         "the issuers, the repository, the Commission or the agency."))
cat(paste(notes[!vapply(notes, is.null, logical(1))], collapse = "\n\n"))
```
